delta: Initial independent findings audit, driver repair verification and final-candidate content bindings.

independence.disclosure: After the independent initial findings, collaboration.list_agents automatically exposed one author completion summary containing counts and generic fix categories. No author finding tables, rationale or report files were opened. Concrete findings were grounded independently in source; repair review used final candidates.

contracts.articles: Public technical explanation, historical report or empirical study; readers assess a claim, inspect sources and judge applicability. Preserve archival uncertainty and measured result tables.
contracts.guides_examples: Technical users follow a bounded operation or inspect a historical design example. Supported commands must match their stated prerequisites and expected output. Historical examples must remain identified.
contracts.references_skills: Readers look up terminology, checks, capabilities and prerequisites. Short descriptions must preserve the limits stated in the full body.
contracts.templates_microcopy: Public readers choose a workflow, download a tool, interpret research state or use an account form. Copy must describe current source behavior and show useful next actions.
contracts.success_evidence: Inferred from those reader actions; no controlled reader study, live-service acceptance or whole-corpus factual certification was performed.

findings.finding: The page mixed unimplemented CLI proposals with a purported executed transcript and measured timings.
findings.evidence: The page identifies lint/query/export as proposals; llmsx/llmsx/__main__.py registers none of them.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Description, transcript and timing status now explicitly historical. Supported hub forms remain.

findings.finding: Thirteen promised page reviews contained only twelve subsections.
findings.evidence: Subsections run 4.1 through 4.12.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Count is twelve; old thirteen-page heading anchor is preserved.

findings.finding: Metadata promised complete exhaustion or zero findings despite documented capped outcomes.
findings.evidence: CFE source distinguishes budget/dissent; rabbithole has maxPasses default 6 and two below-5-percent passes.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Descriptions and opening now state bounded work and explicit stopping outcomes.

findings.finding: The parser emitted keywords: [] directly into Chroma metadata.
findings.evidence: Current official Chroma metadata docs state empty arrays are not allowed. The page showcased an empty array as its first result.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Destination adapter omits empty lists/None and converts nonempty keywords to a scalar string; parser specimen stays labeled before adaptation.

findings.finding: The generated raw FTS5 query was syntactically invalid.
findings.evidence: SQLite FTS5 in-memory reproduction of ("/llms.txt" OR "/llmstxt" OR "llms.txt") discovery raised OperationalError: fts5: syntax error near "discovery".
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Explicit AND joins query groups. Extracted final helper returned the two intended alias rows and excluded unrelated rows.

findings.finding: MCP keyword mode was described as preserving a raw OR/AND expression.
findings.evidence: hub_query_docset calls keyword_query without a raw selector. fts_match defaults to any and quotes whitespace tokens; toy rows containing literal OR or unrelated discovery matched.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Raw-expression instruction is limited to CLI --mode raw; MCP token-any behavior is explicit.

findings.finding: The example wrote llms-topical output but promised default discovery by a server reading llms-concepts.
findings.evidence: llms_serve.py TOPICAL_DIR defaults to core.HUB_DIR/llms-concepts and _topical reads only that parent.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Serve step now sets HUB_LLMS_TOPICAL_DIR to the absolute output parent.

findings.finding: Rubric and pass totals were stale.
findings.evidence: Current rubric contains 67 attribute IDs; current pass page has headings P0 through P19.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Reference now names 67 attributes and P0-P19.

findings.finding: The wider acquisition design was described as implemented behavior.
findings.evidence: llms_acquire.py implements full/index acquisition and reports caller-owned crawl fallback; Accept negotiation and docs-API rungs are not implemented there.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Row distinguishes implemented path from proposed rungs.

findings.finding: The example claimed stdlib-only acquisition without a virtual environment.
findings.evidence: llms_acquire.py _split_lib imports llms_txt.split and raises an explicit dependency ImportError; hub/requirements-dev.txt installs llms-txt.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Prepared hub venv is a prerequisite and acquisition uses its interpreter.

findings.finding: The default server would not discover the example output in cwd/mirrors.
findings.evidence: core.MIRROR_OUT_DIR points to the web-text-mirror skill data; the CLI offers only host and port. serve() accepts mirror_dir.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Launch explicitly supplies mirror_dir=Path("mirrors").

findings.finding: The guide promised rollback for all failed jobs, while valid failed-job tree edits can remain.
findings.evidence: Explorer._job_done restores for timeout/cancel; verify_tree_after_run restores unreadable or structurally invalid trees. Valid error-result trees are retained.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Guide and overview distinguish those outcomes, identify tree-only recovery and instruct diff review.

findings.finding: The stated 3600-second limit omitted provider exceptions.
findings.evidence: explorer.py uses 10800 for Ollama when unset; eGPU uses its separate EGPU_TIMEOUT_S=10800.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Both sections now state normal/Ollama/eGPU limits.

findings.finding: The page generalized selected ranked-domain samples to the general web.
findings.evidence: Its cited evidence page explicitly limits the 5-10 percent figure to selected ranked-domain samples.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Sampling boundary is now retained.

findings.finding: A standalone milestone footer promised a runnable playground without a linked implementation.
findings.evidence: The decision table itself states that future playground step is a plan and not proof of implementation.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Unsupported Runnable in step 4 footers are absent.

findings.finding: The page equated depth saturation with zero new claims and complete exhaustion.
findings.evidence: The actual rule is two consecutive below-5-percent new-information passes within pass/budget limits.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Paragraph states measured low-yield rule, caps and lack of exhaustive proof.

findings.finding: The Markdown privacy notice claimed advertising was disabled while HTML and Base allowed ads.
findings.evidence: Base.astro enables adEligible non-strict non-hidden routes and loads the AdSense script; privacy.astro describes that policy.
findings.criterion: Significant correctness or execution gap that can cause a wrong action.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Twin now describes eligible-page AdSense loading, opt-outs and non-personalized ads consistently.

findings.finding: Retrieval was described as unmetered, conflating usage/quota recording with dollar billing.
findings.evidence: Gateway keyword policy is metered=True,billable=False; semantic/hybrid are separately permissioned and billable. Free semantic policy is demo-only.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: HTML and twin distinguish tracked keyword quota usage from billing and semantic permissions.

findings.finding: All 2900 nodes were labeled researched; frontier explanation omitted queue-only rows.
findings.evidence: Generated data has 2880 researched and 20 domain nodes; frontier sources comprise 6065 child-reference and 167 research-queue rows.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Copy uses mapped topics and includes unchecked queued names. No data or cited fact text was edited for this fix.

findings.finding: The table labeled web execution read-only despite moderator research controls.
findings.evidence: TreeBrowser and reference/concept-tree describe signed-in moderator-triggered POST /api/research.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Comparison distinguishes public generated browsing from moderator research requests.

findings.finding: The step promised three retrieval modes but contained keyword, semantic and a curl serving check.
findings.evidence: The three shown commands contain two queries and one HTTP header check.
findings.criterion: Reduces clarity or makes the published instructions or reference inconsistent.
findings.disposition: Fixed by driver; exact final source re-read and checked.
findings.verified_repair: Label now says keyword and semantic queries plus a local serving check.

verification.recipe12_before: SQLite in-memory FTS5 raised OperationalError: fts5: syntax error near "discovery".
verification.recipe12_after: Exact extracted final expand() produced ("/llms.txt" OR "/llmstxt" OR "llms.txt") AND discovery; matched only the two intended alias/discovery rows; exit 0.
verification.recipe07_after: Exact extracted chroma_metadata() omitted empty keywords and None values, joined nonempty keywords as a scalar, and returned scalar-only output; exit 0.

chroma_official_source.result: Confirms the input schema defect; no live Chroma database was created.

verification.reference_projections: All six generated reference pages equal gen_reference.render(current canonical source). Read-only render comparison; no generation performed by this auditor.
verification.guide_projection: Source and site projection are byte-identical.
verification.queryable_expertise_selected_check: Published evidence JSON agrees with the selected corpus/catalog counts, capture replay, test totals, source revision and explicit partial/native-convergence limits. This is consistency with an author-recorded extract, not independent reexecution.
verification.build_and_live_acceptance: Owned by the parent orchestrator. This reviewer did not run generators, builds, inference or hosted mutations.

preservation.mechanical_scans: Fenced blocks, URL multisets, numeric/identifier deltas and projection equality were checked across the initial corpus. Changed spans received source-based semantic review where read.
preservation.source_code_corrections: Preserved quoted parser output; added a Chroma destination adapter, explicit FTS AND, prepared-interpreter acquisition and explicit serving-directory selections. These changes address the source-grounded execution findings. A Swift optional-format/converter guard and an architectural diagram statement also differ from baseline; this reviewer examined their deltas but did not execute a Swift build.
preservation.limits: Mechanical identity scans do not prove preservation of every prose proposition. No original external URL was removed in the initial-corpus scan. Historical result tables and explicitly unverified financial formulas/ranges retain their archival status.
preservation.excluded: The approximately 3.7 million words of generated cited fact text, embedded full skill prompts, raw reports and third-party mirrors are outside this authored-prose audit. Template review does not verify their facts.

pass_scorecard.0: Writing/technical type, critique, voice, severity and write references loaded. External subject-matter factual coverage remains limited.
pass_scorecard.1: Contracts inferred by document type and preserved outcomes.
pass_scorecard.2: Structure reviewed fully for the full-read subset; introductions/headings/changed spans for remaining articles.
pass_scorecard.3: Selected source-verified technical checks, with executable tutorial defects corrected. Not exhaustive.
pass_scorecard.4: Procedure and directory/schema feasibility checked in selected guides; no end-to-end network/model tutorial execution.
pass_scorecard.5: Failure/rollback and evidence-state risks checked in examined content.
pass_scorecard.6: Concrete count, prerequisite and expectation gaps corrected; no blanket completeness certification.
pass_scorecard.7: Source-grounded account/job workflow and research-control distinctions checked.
pass_scorecard.8: Audience fit reviewed in full-read prose and extracted template copy.
pass_scorecard.9: Task usability reviewed, especially exact commands and next actions.
pass_scorecard.10: Selected sourcing and archival qualification checked.
pass_scorecard.10.5: PARTIAL: no every-claim external verification ledger. This prevents a full-depth clean claim.
pass_scorecard.11: Grounded prescriptions sent to the driver; final source repairs checked.
pass_scorecard.11.5: Contents treated as untrusted data. Benign prompts/code/quotes were not followed as instructions.
pass_scorecard.12: Unsupported milestone footers and inconsistent generated prose corrected.
pass_scorecard.13: Voice reviewed in full-read subset and visible literal copy; not a complete voice audit of the other 36 articles.
pass_scorecard.14: Partial-coverage synthesis; no global convergence or cross-model certification.

limits: Only four of forty articles received full prose reads in this independent context; the other thirty-six received narrower review.
The six copied long references and six canonical sources received changed-span/parity checks, not full prose reads here.
All template files received visible literal/extracted prose review; dynamic output states, accessibility and loaded behavior were not exercised.
Selected authoritative lookups and source reproductions are not exhaustive every-fact verification.
No new claimed benchmark, general model-quality conclusion, financial validation or live deployment acceptance is established.
